passFailChecklist.assertion: Connect-failed title/body/CTA labels match copyLock exactly on desktop and mobile.
Retry action dispatches transport reconnection attempt without clearing room context.
Reconnect timeout shows locked headline/detail copy before results handoff.
Retrying degraded copy interpolates {attempt}/{maxAttempts} token values.
Delayed retrying copy appears only after unresolved retry duration exceeds 5000ms.
Recovery toast appears for 4000ms and clears degraded indicators.
Desktop/mobile flow ordering is identical for connect-fail, timeout, degraded retry, and recovery.
